scoring_justification: The checker recomputes Coulomb energies and luminescence energies from the model parameters given in the instruction and compares the agent's submitted values within tolerances; no self-reported metric is trusted.

outputs.description: Predicted luminescence energies from the point-charge Coulomb model using sp² hole localisation.

output_contract.notes: All numerical inputs are fixed physical constants. The expected values are those given by the model; the agent must compute them from the stated parameters. Floating‑point precision within reasonable tolerance is required.
